import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class K {
        public static long n, m, k, c, d;
    }
    static ArrayList<Long>[] vr = new ArrayList[55];
    static long[] lr = new long[51];
    static final long INF = 1000L * 1000L * 1000L;

    static class Edge {
        long to, cap, cost, flow;
        int rev;
        Edge(long t, long ca, long co, long f, int r) {
            to = t;
            cap = ca;
            cost = co;
            flow = f;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static void add_edge(ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g, long a, long b, long u, long c) {
        Edge e1 = new Edge(b, u, c, 0, g.get((int)b).size());
        Edge e2 = new Edge(a, 0, -c, 0, g.get((int)a).size());
        g.get((int)a).add(e1);
        g.get((int)b).add(e2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        K.n = sc.nextLong();
        K.m = sc.nextLong();
        K.k = sc.nextLong();
        K.c = sc.nextLong();
        K.d = sc.nextLong();

        long tim = 99;
        int N = 50 * 99 + 1;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            g.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        // Initialize vr array
        for (int i = 0; i < 55; i++) {
            vr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        // Read initial positions
        for (int i = 1; i <= K.k; i++) {
            lr[i] = sc.nextLong();
            add_edge(g, 0, (int)lr[i], 1, 0);
        }

        // Connection between consecutive time layers for cities >= 2
        for (int j = 0; j < tim - 1; j++) {
            for (int i = 2; i <= K.n; i++) {
                add_edge(g, j * 50 + i, (j + 1) * 50 + i, 50, K.c);
            }
        }

        // Edges to sink
        for (int j = 1; j < tim; j++) {
            add_edge(g, j * 50 + 1, 1, 50, 0);
        }

        // Read edges and build cross time edges
        for (int i = 0; i < K.m; i++) {
            long x = sc.nextLong();
            long y = sc.nextLong();
            vr[(int)x].add(y);
            vr[(int)y].add(x);
            for (int j = 0; j < tim - 1; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < 50; l++) {
                    long cost = K.c + K.d * ((l + 1) * (l + 1) - l * l);
                    add_edge(g, j * 50 + x, (j + 1) * 50 + y, 1, cost);
                    add_edge(g, j * 50 + y, (j + 1) * 50 + x, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }

        long s = 0, t = 1;
        long flow = 0, cost = 0;
        long k = K.k; // flow to achieve

        while (flow < k) {
            long[] dist = new long[N];
            int[] prevv = new int[N];
            int[] preve = new int[N];
            long[] q = new long[N];
            int[] inq = new int[N];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            int qh = 0, qt = 0;
            q[qt++] = s;
            dist[(int)s] = 0;
            inq[(int)s] = 1;
            while (qh != qt) {
                long v = q[qh++];
                if (qh == N) qh = 0;
                inq[(int)v] = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < g.get((int)v).size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = g.get((int)v).get(i);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[(int)v] + e.cost < dist[(int)e.to]) {
                        dist[(int)e.to] = dist[(int)v] + e.cost;
                        prevv[(int)e.to] = (int)v;
                        preve[(int)e.to] = i;
                        if (inq[(int)e.to] == 0) {
                            q[qt++] = e.to;
                            if (qt == N) qt = 0;
                            inq[(int)e.to] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[(int)t] == INF) break;
            long add = k - flow;
            for (int v = (int)t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                int pv = prevv[v];
                int pe = preve[v];
                add = Math.min(add, g.get(pv).get(pe).cap - g.get(pv).get(pe).flow);
            }
            for (int v = (int)t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                int pv = prevv[v];
                int pe = preve[v];
                int re = g.get(pv).get(pe).rev;
                g.get(pv).get(pe).flow += add;
                g.get(v).get(re).flow -= add;
                cost += g.get(pv).get(pe).cost * add;
            }
            flow += add;
        }
        System.out.println(cost);
    }
}
